modelSteps.title: You invest
modelSteps.description: You commit capital for a defined period (typically 12–36 months). Your investment terms — return rate, payout schedule, and duration — are fixed at contract signing.

modelSteps.title: We buy property
modelSteps.description: Your capital finances the purchase of carefully selected properties. We acquire only assets priced at least 20% below market value, ensuring a built-in margin for your returns and our operations.

modelSteps.title: Renovation and sale
modelSteps.description: We renovate the property to market standard and sell at fair market price. The profit margin covers your fixed return, operating costs, and our profit.

modelSteps.title: You receive returns
modelSteps.description: Throughout the entire investment period, you receive monthly payouts. At the end of the cycle, your full principal is returned. You can then choose to reinvest or withdraw your capital entirely.

items.q: How is the 12% annual return generated?
items.a: Our return comes from the profit margin on real estate transactions. We acquire properties at least 20% below market value, renovate them, and sell at fair market price.
Yes. Every euro you invest is deployed into the acquisition of physical real estate. The entire capital fund is backed by real estate assets.

items.q: What is the typical investment horizon?
items.a: Standard investment periods range from 12 to 24 months. At the end of each period, your full principal is returned along with all earned returns.

items.q: How and when are returns paid out?
items.a: Returns are paid monthly, directly to your bank account. Your monthly payout is calculated as 1/12 of your annual return.

items.q: What is the minimum investment amount?
items.a: The minimum investment is €10,000. Larger investments may qualify for individual terms.

items.q: Can I withdraw my investment early?
items.a: Investments are tied to the agreed period. In exceptional cases, we can accommodate requests subject to an early exit fee.

items.q: Which sectors do you invest in?
items.a: We invest in three main areas — real estate (property flipping), acquisition of established companies (private equity), and secured loans (private credit).

The primary risk is related to real estate market conditions. We mitigate this through conservative acquisition — we only buy properties significantly below market value. Every investment is additionally backed by physical real estate.

items.q: What happens to my capital at the end of the period?
items.a: At the end of the investment period, your full principal is returned along with all earned returns. You can reinvest or withdraw your capital.

items.description: We only buy properties priced 20% or more below market value. This margin protects against market fluctuations and ensures profitability even in adverse conditions.
